newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ROBSON SAYS HE HAS MADE A BID FOR NADAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROBSON SAYS HE HAS MADE A BID FOR NADAL.

text.p: Bryan Robson, manager of English premier league Middlesbrough, confirmed on Monday he had made a bid for Barcelona's brilliant defender Miguel Angel Nadal.
"We put in a bid for Nadal a couple of weeks ago but Barcelona have told us that they want to sign another centre-half before they will let him come to us," said Robson.
"But there is a deadline of December 7 in Spain for signing players, so unless Barcelona get someone in very quickly then it could be difficult for us. We are continuing to monitor the situation."
Two weeks ago Barcelona denied press reports suggesting they were close to exchanging Nadal for Mddlesbrough's troubled Brazilian midfielder Emerson.
Nadal was reported to be unhappy after Barcelona blocked his move to English champions Manchester United.
